pcs.pc_description: create a pattern of the object to be cast
model or pattern of the desired part is made from wood, metal, or plastic
Place a pattern inside a two part frame called a "flask"
mix casting sand with clay and water and tightly packed around the pattern
heat the metal in a furnace until it becomes melt
close the mold and pour the molten metal through the gating system into the cavity
fills the cavity and takes the shape of the part
allow the metal cool and solidfy inside the sand mold
clean the casting and remove the excess sand or any unwanted metal (like the sprue and gates) is cut off
polish and sand the casting to remove rough surfaces, imperfections, or sharp edges
trim the excess metal or flash (the thin layer of metal along the mold lines) by using cutting tools
apply finishing process such as grinding, polishing, or coating, depending on the desired surface finish
